shortDescription: Manage Interface Policy Groups on Cisco Nexus Dashboard Orchestrator (NDO).

options.name: access_macsec_policy
options.description: The access MACsec policy. The value is available only when the mcp_admin_state is C(enabled). The MACsec policy must be defined in the same fabric policy template.

options.name: auto_negotiation
options.description: The auto negotiation state of the port(s) in the interface policy group. The default value is C(on).

options.name: cdp_admin_state
options.description: The CDP admin state enables Cisco Discovery Protocol (CDP) on the interface. The default value is C(disabled).

options.name: controls
options.description: The port-channel control flags of the interface policy group. The default value is C(fast_sel_hot_stdby), C(graceful_conv), C(susp_individual). The value is available only when the interface_type is C(port_channel). Providing an empty list will remove the O(controls) from the interface policy. The old O(controls) will be replaced by the new entries during an update.

options.name: description
options.description: The description of the interface policy group.

options.name: domains
options.description: The domains with which you want to associate this interface policy. The domains must be defined in the same fabric policy template. The old O(domains) will be replaced by the new entries during an update. Providing an empty list will remove the O(domains) from the interface policy.

options.name: host
options.description: IP Address or hostname of the ACI Multi Site Orchestrator host. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: interface_type
options.description: The type of the interface policy group. This parameter is required when interface policy group needs to be created or updated.

options.name: l2_interface_qinq
options.description: The QinQ state for the port(s) in the interface policy group to define how to map double-tagged VLAN traffic. The default value is C(disabled).

options.name: l2_interface_reflective_relay
options.description: Enables or disables reflective relay (802.1Qbg) to forward traffic back to the destination or target. The term Virtual Ethernet Port Aggregator (VEPA) is also used to describe 802.1Qbg functionality. The default value is C(disabled).

options.name: link_level_bring_up_delay
options.description: The time in milliseconds that the decision feedback equalizer (DFE) tuning is delayed when a port is coming up. The default value is 0. The value must be an integer between 0 and 10000.

options.name: link_level_debounce_interval
options.description: The debounce interval of the link level in milliseconds. The default value is 100. The value must be an integer between 0 and 5000.

options.name: link_level_fec
options.description: The type of Forwarding Error Correction (FEC) used by the port(s) in the interface policy group. The default value is C(inherit).

options.name: lldp
options.description: The Link Layer Discovery Protocol (LLDP) configuration of the interface policy group.

options.name: llfc_receive_state
options.description: The LLFC receive state allows LLFC packets to be received by the interface. The default value is C(disabled).

options.name: llfc_transmit_state
options.description: The LLFC transmit state allows Link Level Flow Control (LLFC) packets to be sent from the interface. The default value is C(disabled).

options.name: load_balance_hashing
options.description: The IP header information used by the port-channel load balance hashing algorithm of the interface policy group. The value is available only when the interface_type is C(port_channel).

options.name: login_domain
options.description: The login domain name to use for authentication. The default value is Local. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_LOGIN_DOMAIN) will be used instead. When using a HTTPAPI connection plugin the inventory variable C(ansible_httpapi_login_domain) will be used if this attribute is not specified.

options.name: max_links
options.description: The maximum number of links in a port-channel of the interface policy group. The default value is 16. The value must be between 1 and 64. The value is available only when the interface_type is C(port_channel).

options.name: mcp
options.description: The MisCabling Protocol (MCP) settings.

options.name: min_links
options.description: The minimum number of active links in a port-channel of the interface policy group. The default value is 1. The value must be between 1 and 16. The value is available only when the interface_type is C(port_channel).

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the interface policy group.

options.name: output_level
options.description: Influence the output of this MSO module. C(normal) means the standard output, incl. C(current) dict C(info) adds informational output, incl. C(previous), C(proposed) and C(sent) dicts C(debug) adds debugging output, incl. C(filter_string), C(method), C(response), C(status) and C(url) information If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_OUTPUT_LEVEL) will be used instead.

options.name: password
options.description: The password to use for authentication. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variables C(MSO_PASSWORD) or C(ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: pfc_admin_state
options.description: The Priority Flow Control (PFC) admin state. The default value is C(auto).

options.name: port
options.description: Port number to be used for the REST connection. The default value depends on parameter `use_ssl`. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: port_channel_mode
options.description: The port channel mode of the interface policy group. The default value is C(static_channel_mode_on). The value is available only when the interface_type is C(port_channel).

options.name: speed
options.description: The port speed for the port(s) associated with the interface policy group. The default value is C(inherit).

options.name: state
options.description: Use C(absent) for removing. Use C(query) for listing an object or multiple objects. Use C(present) for creating or updating.

options.name: stp_bpdu_filter
options.description: Enabling the Bridge Protocol Data Unit (BPDU) filter prevents any BPDUs on the port(s) in the interface policy group by filtering the BPDUs. Disabling the BPDU filter allows BPDUs to be received on the port. The default value is C(disabled).

options.name: stp_bpdu_guard
options.description: Enabling the STP BPDU guard shutdown the port(s) by placing them in 'error-disable' mode when BPDUs are received. Disabling the STP BPDU guard allows BPDUs to be received on the port. The default value is C(disabled).

options.name: synce
options.description: The syncE policy assigned to the interface policy group. The syncE policy must be defined in the same fabric policy template.

options.name: template
options.description: The name of the template. The template must be a fabric policy template.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds. The default value is 30 seconds. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_TIMEOUT) will be used instead.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(false), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_USE_PROXY) will be used instead. The default is C(true).

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: If C(false), an HTTP connection will be used instead of the default HTTPS connection. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_USE_SSL) will be used instead. When using a HTTPAPI connection plugin the inventory variable C(ansible_httpapi_use_ssl) will be used if this attribute is not specified. The default is C(false) when using a HTTPAPI connection plugin (mso or nd) and C(true) when using the legacy connection method (only for mso).

options.name: username
options.description: The username to use for authentication. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variables C(MSO_USERNAME) or C(ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME) will be used instead.

options.name: uuid
options.description: The UUID of the interface policy group. This parameter is required when the O(name) attribute needs to be updated.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(false) when used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead. The default is C(true).

options.name: vlan_scope
options.description: The scope of the VLAN encapsulation of the port(s) in the interface policy group. The default value is C(global).
